title.narrative: Nationwide assessments on perinatal deaths, home visiting and HIV are shaping and strengthening life-saving child health systems. Updated telemedicine and home visiting protocols now include disability, improved care quality and access issues. Children received 1,104 telemedicine consultations, while 45,000 newborns benefited from trained professionals and essential equipment for emergency care.
